ProgramUnit.Name: SELECT_DONORS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE select_donors IS
 ---Cursor for Collection Date---
 cursor c1(fdate date,tdate date) is
 SELECT D.DONOR_ID , D.COLL_DATE
 FROM donors b, donations d 
 WHERE d.unit_id is not null 
 AND COLL_DATE BETWEEN fdate AND tdate
 AND D.DONOR_ID=B.DONOR_ID and d.donation_type = 'AL'
 AND NOT EXISTS (select 1 from donor_id_print_det ---- This part added by MG
 where donor_id = b.donor_id ---- To generate only unique
 and trunc(coll_date) between fdate and tdate) ---- CHOL cards.... 8/17/99
 --and d.chapter_id =:global.chapter_id 
 order by unit_id;
 don C1%ROWTYPE;
 temp number;
 doncnt number;
 du_temp number;
 y_n number;
 temp_var varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SET_APPLICATION_PROPERTY(CURSOR_STYLE,'DEFAULT');
 --pitss synchronize;

 if :ctrl_block.search_type='COL' then
 begin 
 select 'x' into temp_var from dual
 where exists 
 (select 'x' from donor_id_print_det 
 where coll_date between :start_date and :end_date);
 set_alert_property('CHOICE_ALERT',alert_message_text,
 'Some cholesterol cards have already been ' || 
 'generated for this date range. Do you want to continue ?'); 
 y_n := show_alert('CHOICE_ALERT');
 if y_n = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 --pitss synchronize;
 check_package_failure;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then 
 null;
 end;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'BUSY');
 go_block('donors');
 set_block_property('donors', insert_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', delete_allowed, property_true);
 set_block_property('donors', update_allowed, property_true);
 clear_block(no_validate);
 doncnt := 0;
 :global.gen_flag := 'D';
 :global.prn_flag := 'D';
 
 FOR don IN c1(:start_date, :end_date)
 LOOP
 
 doncnt := doncnt + 1;
 IF :global.gen_flag = 'D' THEN
 :global.gen_flag := 'E'; 
 END IF;
 :donors.donor_id := don.donor_id;
 :donors.COLL_DATE := don.COLL_DATE;
 
 GET_DONOR_DETAILS;
 IF :donor_id is not null THEN
 next_record;
 
 END IF;
 end loop;
 elsif :ctrl_block.search_type = 'BATCH' THEN
 --set_block_property('DONORS', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 -- 'BATCH_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK.BATCH_ID and chapter_id = '||'''ALL''');
 set_block_property('DONORS', DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'BATCH_ID = :CTRL_BLOCK.BATCH_ID');
 execute_query(no_validate);
 last_record;
 doncnt := :system.cursor_record;
 first_record;
 :global.gen_flag := 'D';
 :global.prn_flag := 'E';
 end if;
 
 if doncnt > 0 then
 GO_RECORD(1);
 if :global.gen_flag = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_print_lbl', enabled, property_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_gen_cards', enabled, property_TRUE);
 elsif :global.prn_flag = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_print_lbl', enabled, property_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_gen_cards', enabled, property_FALSE);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_print_lbl', enabled, property_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_buttons.pb_gen_cards', enabled, property_FALSE);
 end if;
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DONOR_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_DONOR_DETAILS(p_d_e varchar2 := 'N') IS

 szSSNMode NUMBER;

BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_var varchar2(1);
 BEGIN
 
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_var 
 FROM donor_interdictions
 WHERE donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 AND inter_code = 'BADAD'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate)
 AND rownum = 1;
 
 IF p_d_e = 'D' THEN
 show_error('11212');
 ELSIF p_d_e = 'N' THEN
 clear_record;
 return;
 ELSIF p_d_e = 'B' THEN
 clear_record;
 show_error('11212');
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 
 SELECT initcap(last_name) ||', ' ||initcap(first_name) name,
 ssn social,
 date_of_birth, coll_date, 
 decode(h_area_code,null,null,h_area_code || '-') ||
 substr(h_phone_no,1,3) || decode(h_phone_no,null,null,'-') 
 || substr(h_phone_no, -4) phone
 INTO :donors.donor_name, 
 :donors.ssn, 
 :donors.date_of_birth, :donors.coll_date,
 :donors.home_phone_no
 FROM DONORS D, DONATIONS DON, DONOR_ADDRESSES AD
 WHERE D.donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 -- AND D.chapter_id = 'ALL'--:GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND D.donor_id = DON.donor_id
 AND DON.coll_date = (SELECT max(coll_date) FROM DONATIONS
 WHERE donor_id = D.donor_id
 AND unit_id is not null
 AND donation_type = 'AL'
 AND deferral_id is null)
 AND D.donor_id = AD.donor_id
 -- AND DON.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1 ;


--MS
 If SSN_ALLOWED(:banner.user_id) then 

 if :donors.ssn is not null then 
 begin
 Select parameter_value into szSSNMode from valid_parameters 
 where parameter_code = 'SSN_MODE'
 -- and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

 If nvl(szSSNMode,-1) = 4 then
 :donors.ssn := to_char(floor(:donors.ssn/1000000),'099')||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(floor(mod(:donors.ssn,1000000)/10000),'09'))||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(mod(:donors.ssn,10000),'0999')); 
 
 :donors.ssn := '000-00-'||substr(:donors.ssn, -4, 4);
 
 elsif nvl(szSSNMode,-1) = 9 then
 :donors.ssn := to_char(floor(:donors.ssn/1000000),'099')||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(floor(mod(:donors.ssn,1000000)/10000),'09'))||'-'||
 ltrim(to_char(mod(:donors.ssn,10000),'0999')); 
 
 :donors.ssn := ltrim(:donors.ssn);

 end if;
 end;

 end if; 
 
 Else
 if :donors.ssn is not null then
 :donors.ssn :='XXX-XX-XXXX';
 end if;
 
 End If;
--

 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 IF p_d_e = 'D' THEN
 show_error('2306');
 ELSIF p_d_e = 'N' THEN
 clear_record;
 return;
 ELSIF p_d_e = 'B' THEN
 clear_record;
 show_error('2306');
 END IF;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error; 
END;

PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE IS
parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 temp varchar2(40);
 a_port varchar2(40);
 --val varchar2(2000);

 rep_status VARCHAR2(20);

 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;

 
report_id Report_Object;
ReportServerJob VARCHAR2(100);
vc_rep_status VARCHAR2(100);
vjob_id VARCHAR2(100);
--url_val VARCHAR2(200) := NULL; --for ORA11g
--repsvr varchar2(41) := 'rep_iwebbhbc_OraPortal';

 -- Multiple Reports Server feature
 l_svr_name VARCHAR2(100);
 l_svr_url VARCHAR2(100);
 l_err_msg VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN 
 BEGIN 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;

/* Get the report server name from the master code table*/
/* -- Commented on 04/11/2012; Ashok; Below code moved to LTRepServer_Donor.pkg
 BEGIN
 Select description into val 
 from valid_master_codes 
 where code_type='OASVR' 
 and code='RPSVR'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1); 
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 message('Report server is not defined in the SYSPARM table for REPSVR');
 raise form_trigger_failure; 
 End; 
*/
 -- Added on 04/10/2012 to get least active jobs report server name.
 BC_CHECK_REPSERVER.get_reports_server( out_server_name => l_svr_name,
 out_error_msg => l_err_msg
 );

 IF l_err_msg IS NOT NULL THEN
 message('Err ' || l_err_msg);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF l_svr_name IS NULL THEN
 message('Error retrieving Server Name');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF; 
 ------------
--val:='rep_chdevsrv10_oracleas1'; 
--filename:=:rpt_parm.report_name||'_'||'_'||user;
--filename:=:ref_block.report_name||'_'||:ctrl_block.parm_id||'_'||user||'.pdf';


 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;

p := :prog_name||to_char(v_local_date,'HH24MISS') ;
:system.message_level := 10;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status, print_id)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,v_rep_name, p ,
 sysdate,sysdate,'S',:printer_name);
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,parm_no,
 parm_select,parm_code)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,v_rep_name,p,1, 
 :ctrl_block.batch_id ,'MAILD');
 commit;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 
 ---------- 

 IF upper(:printer_name) = 'PDF' then
 filename:='DCIDCARD'||'_'||p||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.pdf';
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(v_rep_name));
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,file);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESNAME,filename);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESFORMAT,'pdf');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');
ELSE
 report_id:= find_report_object('LTREPORTS');
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_FILENAME,lower(v_rep_name));
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_COMM_MODE,ASYNCHRONOUS);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_EXECUTION_MODE,BATCH);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_DESTYPE,printer);

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHOL_CARD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE print_chol_card IS
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 batch_queue rpt_report_names.batch_queue%type;
 temp_return number;
 filename varchar2(100);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dest_parm'; 
 rep_dir varchar2(30);
 p varchar2(20);
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button NUMBER;
 ctype varchar2(5);
Begin
 al_id := Find_Alert('choice_alert'); 
 set_alert_property(al_id,alert_message_text,'Is printer '||:printer_name||' loaded with Cholestrol Cards?');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 p := :prog_name||to_char(sysdate,'HH24MISS') ;
 begin
 select parameter_value into rep_dir from valid_parameters
 where parameter_code = 'REPSOURCE' 
 and parameter_type = 'ALL'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 exception
 when others then
 message('REPSOURCE parameter not defined: Contact IS');pause;
 end;
 filename := 'R:\'||'DCRMAILD'||'_'||p||'_'||LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid||'.r';
 :system.message_level := 10;
 begin
 insert into rpt_parm
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,
 parm_date,submit_date,report_status, print_id)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,'DCRMAILD', p ,
 sysdate,sysdate,'S',:printer_name);
 insert into rpt_parm_select
 (appl_id,user_name,report_name,parm_id,parm_no,
 parm_select,parm_code)
 values('DON',:banner.user_id,'DCRMAILD',p,1, 
 :ctrl_block.batch_id ,'MAILD');
 commit;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 end;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 begin 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id) ;
 end if ;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF; 
 end; 
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'FILE');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESNAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,filename) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'DESFORMAT',TEXT_PARAMETER,'dflt');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'P_PARM_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER, p) ;
 add_parameter(pl_id,'AUTO_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,'Y');
 add_parameter(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:printer_name);
 rp2rro.rp2rro_run_product(REPORTS,'DCRMAILD',ASYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,null);
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 item_change('pb_print_lbl', 'D');
 END IF; 
END;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_DATES
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** this block validate the date range
*/
declare
 s_local_date date;
begin
 
 s_local_date:=lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_block.end_date is null and 
 :system.trigger_item = 'CTRL_BLOCK.END_DATE' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11067');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.start_date > trunc(s_local_date) then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date > trunc(s_local_date) then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('18014');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :ctrl_block.end_date is not null then
 if :ctrl_block.start_date > :ctrl_block.end_date then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve', enabled, property_false);
 show_error('11065');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
exception
 when value_error then
 show_error('9191');
 raise form_trigger_failure;

end;
